passageTitle: Questions 176–180 refer to the following order form and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Office Supply Order #5021

Customer: Bright Future Design  |  Order Date: March 3

  • 5 boxes of A4 Copy Paper ($20 each) = $100
  • 10 packs of Sticky Notes ($3 each) = $30
  • 2 Desk Organizers ($15 each) = $30

Total Paid: $160 (Free standard shipping)

Document 2: E-mail

To: support@quickoffice.com
From: Laura Chen <laura@brightfuture.com>
Date: March 6
Subject: Missing Items in Order #5021

Hello,

Our package for Order #5021 arrived this morning. Thank you for the fast delivery. However, when I opened the box, I noticed that only 3 boxes of A4 Copy Paper were inside instead of 5. The sticky notes and desk organizers were all there.

Could you please send the remaining 2 boxes of paper as soon as possible? You can reach me at 555-0192 if needed.

Thank you,
Laura Chen

questions.q: Who placed Order #5021?
questions.translation: Ai đã đặt đơn hàng #5021?
questions.explanation: Trong Document 1, mục Customer ghi 'Bright Future Design'.

questions.q: How much did one Desk Organizer cost?
questions.translation: Một chiếc hộp đựng đồ trên bàn làm việc giá bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation: Document 1 ghi: '2 Desk Organizers ($15 each) = $30'.

questions.q: When did the package arrive at Bright Future Design?
questions.translation: Gói hàng đã đến công ty Bright Future Design vào ngày nào?
questions.explanation: Email gửi ngày March 6 và Laura viết: 'Our package for Order #5021 arrived this morning'.

questions.q: What problem does Laura mention in her e-mail?
options: The desk organizers were the wrong color.
Two boxes of A4 copy paper were missing.
The delivery fee was too high.
questions.translation: Laura đề cập đến vấn đề gì trong email?
questions.explanation: Laura viết chỉ có 3 thùng giấy A4 thay vì 5 thùng, và yêu cầu gửi thêm 2 thùng còn lại.

questions.q: What does Laura ask Quick Office to do?
options: Send the remaining 2 boxes of paper
questions.translation: Laura yêu cầu Quick Office làm gì?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối email viết: 'Could you please send the remaining 2 boxes of paper as soon as possible?'.

passageTitle: Questions 181–185 refer to the following advertisement and text message chain.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Advertisement

GLOBAL ENGLISH ACADEMY — EVENING CLASSES

Improve your English speaking and writing skills after work!

  • Level 1 (Beginner): Mondays & Wednesdays, 6:30 P.M. – 8:00 P.M.
  • Level 2 (Intermediate): Tuesdays & Thursdays, 6:30 P.M. – 8:00 P.M.

Tuition: $120 per month (includes textbook). Register before April 15 to get a $20 discount!

Document 2: Text Message Chain

Ken (4:10 P.M.): Hi Lisa! Did you see the flyer for Global English Academy?

Lisa (4:12 P.M.): Yes! I want to join the Level 1 class because I need to practice basic speaking.

Ken (4:14 P.M.): Me too! Let's sign up today since it's April 12. We can save $20.

Lisa (4:15 P.M.): Good idea! By the way, I can't drive on Wednesdays, so let's take the subway together after work.

questions.q: When are the Level 1 classes held?
questions.translation: Các lớp Level 1 được tổ chức vào khi nào?
questions.explanation: Document 1 ghi: 'Level 1 (Beginner): Mondays & Wednesdays, 6:30 P.M. – 8:00 P.M.'.

questions.q: What is included in the monthly tuition?
questions.translation: Học phí hàng tháng bao gồm những gì?
questions.explanation: Quảng cáo ghi: '$120 per month (includes textbook)'.

questions.q: Why does Lisa want to take the Level 1 class?
options: She wants to study on Tuesdays.
She wants to practice basic speaking.
Her boss asked her to teach.
questions.translation: Tại sao Lisa muốn học lớp Level 1?
questions.explanation: Lisa nhắn: 'I want to join the Level 1 class because I need to practice basic speaking'.

questions.q: How much will Ken pay for the first month if he signs up on April 12?
questions.translation: Ken sẽ trả bao nhiêu cho tháng đầu tiên nếu đăng ký vào ngày 12 tháng 4?
questions.explanation: Học phí $120/tháng, đăng ký trước ngày 15/4 được giảm $20 (như Ken nói 'We can save $20'), nên còn $100.

questions.q: How does Lisa suggest going to the class?
questions.translation: Lisa gợi ý đi đến lớp học bằng phương tiện gì?
questions.explanation: Tin nhắn cuối Lisa viết: 'so let's take the subway together after work'.

passageTitle: Questions 186–190 refer to the following schedule, e-mail, and reply.
passageHtml:
Document 1: City Book Fair — Saturday, October 10

  • 10:00 A.M.: Opening Ceremony (Main Hall)
  • 11:00 A.M.: Author Talk with Daniel Ross (Room A)
  • 1:30 P.M.: Children's Storytelling (Room B)
  • 3:00 P.M.: Cooking Book Signing by Chef Grace (Room A)

Document 2: E-mail

To: info@citybookfair.org
From: Kevin Park
Subject: Question about Saturday Events

Hello, I am planning to attend the City Book Fair on October 10. I really want to meet Author Daniel Ross and get his new travel book signed. Do I need to buy a special ticket for his talk in Room A?

Document 3: E-mail Reply

To: Kevin Park
From: City Book Fair Team

Dear Kevin, thank you for your e-mail! All talks and book signings are free with a $5 general entry ticket. Please note that Daniel Ross's talk has been moved from Room A to the Main Hall so more people can sit down.

questions.q: When will the City Book Fair take place?
questions.translation: Hội chợ sách thành phố sẽ diễn ra khi nào?
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề Document 1 ghi: 'City Book Fair — Saturday, October 10'.

questions.q: What event is scheduled for 1:30 P.M.?
questions.translation: Sự kiện nào diễn ra vào lúc 1:30 chiều?
questions.explanation: Lịch trình ghi '1:30 P.M.: Children's Storytelling (Room B)'.

questions.q: What kind of book did Daniel Ross write?
questions.translation: Daniel Ross đã viết thể loại sách gì?
questions.explanation: Trong Document 2, Kevin viết: 'meet Author Daniel Ross and get his new travel book signed'.

questions.q: How much does Kevin need to pay to attend Daniel Ross's talk?
questions.translation: Kevin cần trả bao nhiêu để tham dự buổi nói chuyện của Daniel Ross?
questions.explanation: Document 3 trả lời: 'All talks and book signings are free with a $5 general entry ticket'.

questions.q: Where will Daniel Ross's talk actually be held?
questions.translation: Buổi nói chuyện của Daniel Ross thực tế sẽ được tổ chức ở đâu?
questions.explanation: Document 3 thông báo: 'Daniel Ross's talk has been moved from Room A to the Main Hall'.

passageTitle: Questions 191–195 refer to the following price list, repair ticket, and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Document 1: TechCare Computer Repair — Price List

  • Screen Replacement: $120
  • Battery Replacement: $60
  • Keyboard Repair: $45
  • System Check & Cleaning: $25

Document 2: Repair Ticket #884

Customer: Daniel Kim  |  Phone: 555-0144
Device: Silver Laptop  |  Drop-off Date: November 2
Requested Service: Battery Replacement

Document 3: E-mail from TechCare

To: Daniel Kim
Date: November 3
Subject: Update on Repair Ticket #884

Dear Mr. Kim, we have replaced the battery on your silver laptop. While testing the laptop, our technician also noticed that your cooling fan was very dusty and performed a System Check & Cleaning at no extra charge. Your laptop is ready for pickup today until 7:00 P.M.

questions.q: Which service costs $45 at TechCare?
questions.translation: Dịch vụ nào có giá 45 đô la tại TechCare?
questions.explanation: Trong Document 1, mục Keyboard Repair có giá $45.

questions.q: When did Daniel Kim bring his laptop to the shop?
questions.translation: Daniel Kim đã mang máy tính xách tay đến cửa hàng khi nào?
questions.explanation: Document 2 ghi: 'Drop-off Date: November 2'.

questions.q: How much will Daniel Kim have to pay in total?
questions.translation: Daniel Kim sẽ phải trả tổng cộng bao nhiêu tiền?
questions.explanation: Ông Kim yêu cầu Battery Replacement ($60). Dịch vụ System Check & Cleaning được làm 'at no extra charge' (miễn phí thêm), nên tổng vẫn là $60.

questions.q: What extra problem did the technician find?
questions.translation: Kỹ thuật viên đã phát hiện thêm vấn đề gì?
questions.explanation: Document 3 viết: 'our technician also noticed that your cooling fan was very dusty'.

questions.q: By what time can Daniel Kim pick up his laptop today?
questions.translation: Hôm nay Daniel Kim có thể đến nhận lại máy tính trước mấy giờ?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối Document 3 ghi: 'Your laptop is ready for pickup today until 7:00 P.M.'.

passageTitle: Questions 196–200 refer to the following notice, task list, and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Document 1: Meeting Room Change Notice

Please note that Friday's Marketing Team Meeting (10:00 A.M.) has been moved from Room 301 to Room 405 because the air conditioner in Room 301 is being repaired.

Document 2: Meeting Task List

  • Bring printed reports: Rachel
  • Set up projector: Ben
  • Order coffee & snacks: Mia
  • Take meeting notes: Sam

Document 3: E-mail

To: Marketing Team
From: Ben Taylor
Subject: Friday Meeting

Hi everyone, I have a dentist appointment on Friday morning, so I will arrive at 10:30 A.M. instead of 10:00 A.M. Could someone else please handle my task before the meeting starts in Room 405? Thanks, Ben.

questions.q: Why was the meeting moved to Room 405?
options: The air conditioner in Room 301 is being repaired.
questions.translation: Tại sao cuộc họp được chuyển sang Phòng 405?
questions.explanation: Document 1 ghi: 'because the air conditioner in Room 301 is being repaired'.

questions.q: Who is responsible for ordering coffee and snacks?
questions.translation: Ai chịu trách nhiệm đặt cà phê và đồ ăn nhẹ?
questions.explanation: Trong Document 2, dòng 'Order coffee & snacks: Mia'.

questions.q: Why will Ben be late for the meeting on Friday?
options: He is picking up printed reports.
He is fixing the air conditioner.
questions.translation: Tại sao Ben sẽ đến họp muộn vào thứ Sáu?
questions.explanation: Trong Document 3, Ben viết: 'I have a dentist appointment on Friday morning'.

questions.q: What task does Ben need someone else to do?
questions.translation: Ben cần người khác làm giúp nhiệm vụ gì?
questions.explanation: Kết hợp Document 2 ('Set up projector: Ben') và Document 3 ('Could someone else please handle my task'), nhiệm vụ của Ben là lắp đặt máy chiếu.

questions.q: What time will Ben arrive at Room 405?
questions.translation: Ben sẽ đến Phòng 405 lúc mấy giờ?
questions.explanation: Ben viết trong email: 'so I will arrive at 10:30 A.M. instead of 10:00 A.M.'.
